::: {#rem-collatz-loop}
#### A loop nobody knows how to stop

The process of @exm-collatz is the loop

```text
while n != 1
    if n is even
        n := n / 2
    else
        n := 3 * n + 1
```

on a positive integer $n$.
Nobody knows whether it stops for every positive integer $n$:
that is the Collatz conjecture [@wikipedia_collatz_conjecture].
So nobody has found a loop variant (@def-loop-variant) for it,
since @thm-variant-terminates would then prove that it always stops.
Termination is a separate claim from what an invariant gives,
and it can be the hard part.

:::
